evidence: The surface compositions of the catalysts were studied using low-energy ion scattering (LEIS) and X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS). The nickel content was determined using X-ray fluorescence (XRF). Possible crystalline nickel species and alumina phase ratios were determined by means of X-ray diffraction. The specific surface area, SA, pore volume, PV, and average pore diameter, dp, of the alumina and the catalysts were determined using nitrogen adsorption and condensation (BET-analysis).
